samples.name: terrain-trampled-earth
samples.prompt: ONE RPG sprite. Reference images Tiny Town and Tiny Farm define the simple flat low-resolution pixel-art style. Packed brown earth around a campfire, a few pebbles and ash specks. No fire, no logs, no grass. Seamless opaque full-bleed terrain, viewed straight down. Intended native size 16x16, with matching square proportions. Uniform square pixel grid enlarged for output. Very simple silhouette, sparse details, muted natural colors, 2-3 shades per material. No gradients, soft texture, tiny speckles, outlines outside the silhouette, glow, frame or text.
